name: Grisha
source: University student and barista at the local Moonbucks in the city of G. During his shifts, he meets all kinds of visitors with all sorts of baggage. Besides cracking open a cold BaltiCo with Pyotr, his favorite pastime is hitting the internet café to lurk in the online chat Brainbridge, chasing urban legends of G. Amid rumors of a local girl going insane and eventually meeting her untimely demise, a tech-savvy chat member recovers a cursed image file from the dead girl’s hard drive — and, of course, shares it with the chat and Grisha.
